description: Jason's freshly painted white car gets secretly wrapped in an anime livery by Yago: 'Yago wibu, kocak!' Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-wibu/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-wibu.mp4): 6 pieces (0.6 s padding each; piece A, the mod shop at h1 18:45, is unused: the facecam moves into the mod-shop menu there) of windah-live12/stream-1904-2004.mp4 (h1) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 1176.20-1177.40 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; B t 1149.50-1156.60 = local 6.60-13.70 -> output 1.20-8.30; C t 1159.80-1162.45 = local 14.90-17.55 -> output 8.30-10.95; C t 1163.15-1166.40 = local 18.25-21.50 -> output 10.95-14.20; C t 1168.75-1175.60 = local 23.85-30.70 -> output 14.20-21.05; D t 1180.60-1183.00 = local 31.90-34.30 -> output 21.05-23.45; E t 1194.05-1197.40 = local 35.50-38.85 -> output 23.45-26.80. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h1 19:36, the wrapped car); Yago 'missing one little thing' over the plain white car, 'apa yang belum ada?' (h1 19:09); the reveal and 'bocil ganti-ganti desain ... Yago wibu, kocak' (h1 19:19-19:35); 'gila, Yago wibu rupanya' (h1 19:40); driving off, 'gak ada gunanya gue cat putih tadi' (h1 19:54). Word timings from faster-whisper medium on a short window. CUT: both 'mampus' (h1 19:22.6, 19:26.5) and the hood close-up from ~19:43 (the anime girl on the hood shows cleavage); the wide side shots keep the livery small. Shop and livery logos are the game's own fictional brands. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame. Main 26.80 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1488x837 at (0,64) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'MOBIL GUE DIUBAH', line 2 Volt 'JADI MOBIL WIBU', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
